# Education to the Core

> > Education to the Core provides comprehensive, Science of Reading-aligned printable worksheets, lesson plans, and classroom materials for K-3 elementary teachers.

Education to the Core is a leading resource platform for primary grade educators, offering both free and premium printable worksheets across literacy and math instruction. The site features curated materials developed by experienced educators and is accessible through both standard and premium subscription models.

## Key Topics

- Science of Reading
- Phonics
- Phonemic Awareness
- Reading Comprehension
- Sight Words
- Fluency
- Grammar & Writing
- Math Worksheets
- Literacy Centers
- Classroom Materials
- Printable Resources
- Primary Grades (K-3)
- Lesson Plans
- Google Classroom Integration
- Teacher Resources

## Core Resources & Shop

- [Homepage](https://educationtothecore.com): Main hub for Education to the Core with printable worksheets and lesson plans.
- [Shop](https://educationtothecore.com/shop): Main shop catalog for educational products and teaching resources.
- [Premium Resources](https://premium.educationtothecore.com): Premium subscription resource library with K-3 curriculum materials.
- [All Premium Resources](https://premium.educationtothecore.com/resources): Premium resource library with lesson plans and classroom activities.
- [Premium Value & Membership](https://premium.educationtothecore.com/premiumvalue): Premium subscription pricing and membership benefits overview.

## Reading & Literacy Instruction

- [Reading Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/reading): Reading worksheets category with phonics and comprehension resources.
- [Phonics Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/reading/phonics): Science of Reading phonics worksheets and literacy centers.
- [Phonemic Awareness Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/reading/phonemic-awareness): Phonemic awareness worksheets for early literacy development.
- [Reading Comprehension Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/reading/reading-comprehension): Reading comprehension worksheets for elementary literacy instruction.
- [Fluency Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/reading/fluency): Fluency worksheets and passages for K-3 reading instruction.
- [Sight Words Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/reading/sight-words): Sight words and Fry Words worksheets for K-3 fluency practice.

## Grammar & Writing

- [Grammar & Writing Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/reading/grammar-writing): Grammar and writing worksheets for primary grade instruction.
- [Types of Writing](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/grammar-writing/types-of-writing): Writing types including narrative, opinion, and informative writing.
- [Parts of Speech Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/grammar-writing/parts-of-speech): Parts of speech worksheets for elementary grammar instruction.
- [Sentence Structure Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/grammar-writing/sentence-structure): Sentence structure worksheets and grammar practice activities.
- [Conventions Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/grammar-writing/conventions): Writing conventions and punctuation worksheets for primary grades.

## Mathematics

- [Math Worksheets](https://educationtothecore.com/product-category/math): Math worksheets and centers for elementary instruction.
